# Cancer Data Showcase

> A question-first guide to NCI-supported cancer datasets: what each one can answer, what it cannot, who has already reused it, and a runnable way to start. 602 dataset records across 5 repositories.

Every claim carries provenance. Structured records expose measured clinical field completeness, graded reuse evidence, and explicit blocking limitations.

## How to use this if you are an agent

1. Read a dataset's blocking limitations BEFORE its capabilities. FM-AD holds 18,004 patients whose vital status is populated for every case and informative for none; it will support no survival analysis at any sample size.
2. Filter on measured capability (`has_survival_endpoint`, `has_treatment_response`), not on description text.
3. `has_citable_accession: false` means reuse could not be measured, not that the dataset is unused.

## Data

- [Search index](https://cancer-data-showcase.example.org/data/index.json): one slim row per dataset
- [Facets](https://cancer-data-showcase.example.org/data/facets.json): browse dimensions with counts
- [Subject vocabulary](https://cancer-data-showcase.example.org/data/subjects.json): controlled tissues and query synonyms
- [Corpus statistics](https://cancer-data-showcase.example.org/data/stats.json)
- [Research questions](https://cancer-data-showcase.example.org/data/questions.json): curated questions, flattened
- [Full record](https://cancer-data-showcase.example.org/data/datasets/{id}.json): everything, with evidence
- [Agent brief](https://cancer-data-showcase.example.org/data/agent/{id}.md): plain-language, constraints first
- [schema.org JSON-LD](https://cancer-data-showcase.example.org/data/jsonld/{id}.jsonld)
- [MLCommons Croissant](https://cancer-data-showcase.example.org/data/croissant/{id}.json)
- [Reuse gap model](https://cancer-data-showcase.example.org/data/reuse_gap_model.json): coefficients and diagnostics
- [Field calibration](https://cancer-data-showcase.example.org/data/field_calibration.json): why the reuse method uses the fields it uses, re-measured on every build

## Live endpoints

- `GET https://cancer-data-showcase.example.org/api/v1/search` - filter on measured capability: `survival`, `treatment_response`, `subject`, `site`, `modality`, `access`, `repository`, `min_cases`, `min_modalities`, `underexplored`, `showcase`, `q`, `limit`
- `GET https://cancer-data-showcase.example.org/api/v1/datasets/{id}` - the full record plus `analysis_fit`, the six verdicts
- `GET https://cancer-data-showcase.example.org/api/v1/agent?q=...` - describe an analysis, get a ranked shortlist with the reasons and the blockers (`POST` with `{"q": "..."}` also works)
- [OpenAPI description](https://cancer-data-showcase.example.org/openapi.json)

## Method notes that change how you should read the numbers

- Reuse is graded by where an accession appears in an article. Methods, results, tables and figures count as analysis; a reference-list mention does not.
- Availability is dated from the first article referencing the accession, because repository file timestamps record re-harmonization rather than first release.
- 'Underexplored' is a modeled residual against datasets matched on size, age, modality breadth and access tier - never an editorial judgement.

## Showcase datasets (20)

- [Acute Myeloid Leukemia](https://cancer-data-showcase.example.org/datasets/gdc-target-aml): 2,492 children and young adults with acute myeloid leukaemia - the largest paediatric cancer genomics cohort in this corpus, with 3.5 years of median follow-up and therapeutic agents recorded for 35% of cases.
- [Breast Invasive Carcinoma](https://cancer-data-showcase.example.org/datasets/gdc-tcga-brca): 1,098 breast tumors measured twelve ways across GDC and IDC, with treatment outcome on 64% of cases - the most reused dataset in this corpus and still the reference cohort for method development.
- [CPTAC AML Study](https://cancer-data-showcase.example.org/datasets/pdc-cptac-aml-study): 164 acute myeloid leukaemias with proteome, phosphoproteome, acetylome and glycoproteome, plus lipidomics and metabolomics on 98 - one of only three NCI cohorts carrying lipidomic data, openly downloadable.
- [CPTAC LUAD Discovery Study](https://cancer-data-showcase.example.org/datasets/pdc-cptac-luad-discovery-study): 115 lung adenocarcinomas with proteome, phosphoproteome and acetylome, plus ubiquitylome on 80 - one of five ubiquitylation datasets in the Proteomic Data Commons, openly downloadable.
- [CPTAC STAD Study](https://cancer-data-showcase.example.org/datasets/pdc-cptac-stad-study): 193 gastric cancers measured seven ways - proteome, phosphoproteome, acetylome, glycoproteome, ubiquitylome, metabolome and protein-protein interaction - the deepest single-cohort molecular characterization in the NCI portfolio, and openly downloadable.
- [CPTAC-Brain, Head and Neck, Kidney, Lung, Pancreas, Uterus](https://cancer-data-showcase.example.org/datasets/gdc-cptac-3): 1,866 tumors across six cancer types with genomics in the GDC and proteomics in the PDC - the largest prospectively collected proteogenomic cohort, with recurrence recorded for 78% of cases.
- [CTSP Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma (DLBCL) CALGB 50303](https://cancer-data-showcase.example.org/datasets/gdc-ctsp-dlbcl1): 45 diffuse large B-cell lymphomas from the randomized CALGB 50303 trial - small, but every case has complete vital status, five years of median follow-up, and a known randomized treatment assignment.
- [Comprehensive genomic characterization of radiation-related papillary thyroid cancer in the Ukraine](https://cancer-data-showcase.example.org/datasets/gdc-rebc-thyr): 449 papillary thyroid carcinomas from Ukrainians exposed to Chernobyl fallout as children - an irreplaceable radiation-exposure cohort with essentially no clinical annotation and no usable outcome data at all.
- [Foundation Medicine Adult Cancer Clinical Dataset (FM-AD)](https://cancer-data-showcase.example.org/datasets/gdc-fm-ad): 18,004 patients profiled with a targeted clinical panel - the largest cohort in the Genomic Data Commons, with no informative vital status, no race data, and no treatment records.
- [Genomic Characterization of Metastatic Castration Resistant Prostate Cancer](https://cancer-data-showcase.example.org/datasets/gdc-wcdt-mcrpc): 101 metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancers with whole genome and RNA sequencing from metastatic biopsies - every case stage IV with documented progression, and no usable vital status.
- [Glioblastoma Multiforme](https://cancer-data-showcase.example.org/datasets/gdc-tcga-gbm): 617 glioblastomas with twelve measurement types including radiology on 607 and pathology slides on 389 - the reference glioma cohort, with a median follow-up of 12.0 months.
- [HIV+ Tumor Molecular Characterization Project - Cervical Cancer](https://cancer-data-showcase.example.org/datasets/gdc-cgci-htmcp-cc): 212 cervical carcinomas from Ugandan women, 98% Black African and enriched for HIV infection - the largest genomically characterized cervical cancer cohort from sub-Saharan Africa, with ECOG status on 99% of cases, treatment outcome on 68%, and a derivable follow-up time for every single case.
- [HIV+ Tumor Molecular Characterization Project - Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma](https://cancer-data-showcase.example.org/datasets/gdc-cgci-htmcp-dlbcl): 70 diffuse large B-cell lymphomas from an HIV-enriched cohort, half Black or African American, with whole genome sequencing on 66 and named chemotherapy regimens on a quarter.
- [HIV+ Tumor Molecular Characterization Project - Lung Cancer](https://cancer-data-showcase.example.org/datasets/gdc-cgci-htmcp-lc): 39 lung cancers from an HIV-enriched cohort, two thirds Black or African American, with whole genome sequencing on every case and clinical staging on 62% - very small, and addressing a population that appears in almost no lung cancer genomics.
- [Molecular Profiling to Predict Response to Treatment for Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia](https://cancer-data-showcase.example.org/datasets/gdc-mp2prt-all): 1,510 children with acute lymphoblastic leukaemia from Children's Oncology Group trials, with whole genome sequencing, 8.4 years of median follow-up, and a named treatment regimen and response recorded for every single case.
- [NCI Cancer Model Development for the Human Cancer Model Initiative](https://cancer-data-showcase.example.org/datasets/gdc-hcmi-cmdc): 805 next-generation cancer models - organoids and other patient-derived systems - with whole genome sequencing on 804 and the matched patient tumor, spanning many rare cancers.
- [NSCLC Radiogenomics](https://cancer-data-showcase.example.org/datasets/idc-nsclc-radiogenomics): 211 non-small cell lung cancers with pre-surgical CT and PET/CT, semantic annotations, segmentations and matched gene expression - a genuinely paired imaging-genomics cohort, fully open, and described only in prose.
- [Omic and Multidimensional Spatial Atlas of Metastatic Breast Cancers](https://cancer-data-showcase.example.org/datasets/htan-omic-and-multidimensional-spatial-atlas-of-metastatic-breast-cancers): Serial biopsies from metastatic breast cancer patients measured nine ways including electron microscopy, Visium spatial transcriptomics, multiplexed imaging and single-cell ATAC - 120,000 files, and the only electron microscopy in the corpus.
- [Pancreas Cancer Organoid Profiling](https://cancer-data-showcase.example.org/datasets/gdc-organoid-pancreatic): 70 patient-derived pancreatic cancer organoids with exome and RNA sequencing, linked to drug-response profiling in the source publication - a living model resource rather than a tissue archive.
- [The Cellular Geography of Therapeutic Resistance in Cancer](https://cancer-data-showcase.example.org/datasets/htan-the-cellular-geography-of-therapeutic-resistance-in-cancer): An HTAN atlas built explicitly around therapeutic resistance, with multiplexed imaging, single-cell RNA sequencing and the richest clinical annotation of any atlas here - and no publications recorded in the network's own manifest.
